purpose: Add same-model plain references alongside compatible frozen Buddha results, retaining the original bounded improver question.
instrument: Unchanged selected official NoveltyBench 1.1 release, judges, prompts, schemas and fallback.
selection: All original prospectively declared roles/starts/repetitions; no favorable posthoc source or mode selection.
aggregation: Average original starts and repetitions within each prompt/role before comparing to each available plain reference; equally weight declared prompts and retain original families.
missing: Keep full planned coverage and reasons. No zero imputation or complete-case winner claim; missing required cells or scalars makes the affected comparison incomplete.
raw_reference_reuse: One reference observation reused across Buddha conditions remains one observation, not independent duplicated samples.
inference: Descriptive paired outcomes only at this proposal stage; no significance, promotion, generalization, human preference or useful-diversity improvement claim.
sampling: Treat arbitrary evolved generation as its actual declared procedure. Mode labels alone do not establish independent or in-context compliance.
resources: Bind model access/output allowance and disclose all actual calls, billed tokens including reasoning, failures, planning/selection, and per-role/total research costs. Equal ceilings do not mean equal actual consumption.
provenance: Require prospective control bindings in original Buddha and reference inputs, original complete owner/authority/seal evidence, matching dataset/task/release/judge/generator settings and a checked passive consumer.
partial_results: Retain original stage, reason, coverage, costs and unresolved holds. Never rerun merely to replace an unfavorable outcome.
human_review: Existing Buddha-only human selectors do not establish a human comparison against new raw references; any extension is separately declared.
funding: No reference allocation or enlargement/reuse of the existing proposed $150 scope. Exact combined workload, analysis, capacity, accounts and funding remain pre-live requirements.
